title: The watcher's 256-directory fallback fences every carried gate before the .tmp/ scratch exemption is applied
outcome: A watcher batch whose paths all lie under a worktree's own `.tmp/` does not fence carried gates, however many directories it touches; the fallback counts only directories that still need routing.
acceptance: A batch of more than 256 directories with at least one source path still fences every carried check; a test pins it.
A test delivers a batch of changes in more than 256 directories, all under a gate worktree's `.tmp/`: the carried check is not fenced.
The full gate passed on the exact landed input.
